description: GLM 5.3 Uncensored TEE is Phala's uncensored LoRA for Z.AI's open-weight GLM-5.3, served on NVFP4 weights. It is a separate model from GLM 5.3 Uncensored, with different weights. It refuses far less while keeping tool calling, structured output and the 1M-token context. A built-in system message, placed before yours, treats file, web and tool content as untrusted. Text only. Reasoning is always on; choose low, high, or max reasoning effort (defaults to high). Runs inside a TEE (Trusted Execution Environment), with provider attestation and signed completion receipts.
name: GLM 5.3 Uncensored TEE
